name: Happy Valentine ♥
source:
"Today is Valentine's Day!

Plus, It's Gideon's birthday!

Albert really needs to wake up or Gideon will be super mad. Don't be late!"

[From [url=https://verian12.itch.io/happy-valentine]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“今天是情人节！

而且，还是吉迪恩的生日！

阿尔伯特得赶紧起床，不然吉迪恩会气坏的。千万别迟到！”

[摘自[url=https://verian12.itch.io/happy-valentine]itch.io[/url]]
